fields.why: Prevalence is compared across 4 age groups, 5 race/ethnicity groups, and education, income and insurance levels.
Sex, rurality, SOGI and disability are two-group contrasts; region and marital status are not SPDs.

The Table claims ('higher among ... than among ...') under a blanket chi-square statement are per-group vs referent only. The Figure 2 'highest' race claims within depression strata have no test (the figure notes list only within-group trend tests, a non-SPD contrast under rule 6), so side by side holds; the mechanical flag is a false alarm.
